tools.name: ai_chat
tools.description: Chat with getqueryly AI. Ask questions, generate content, search the web. Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: ds_upload
tools.description: Upload a data file for AI analysis. Supports CSV, Excel, JSON, PDF, images, SPSS, Parquet. Returns session_id. Free.

tools.name: ds_query
tools.description: Ask a question about uploaded data. AI writes and runs Python code. Returns analysis with charts. Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: analyze_file
tools.description:
ONE-CALL deep analysis (v2): upload a file and get quality score, top
    insights, a summary and the headline chart — no session juggling.
    Without a question: full analysis (2 Makes). With a question: answers
    just that question (1 Make). Returns structured JSON.

tools.name: ds_health_check
tools.description: Run a data health check. Detects missing values, outliers, type issues, duplicates. Costs 2 Makes.

tools.name: ds_insights
tools.description: Get automatic insights from data: patterns, anomalies, trends, correlations. Costs 3 Makes.

tools.name: ds_swarm
tools.description: Run analyst swarm: multiple AI personas analyze your data independently, then synthesize consensus. Depth: quick (5 Makes) or full (8 Makes).

tools.name: ds_report
tools.description: Generate a PDF report from data analysis. Includes charts, stats, insights. Costs 3 Makes.

tools.name: smart_test
tools.description: AI picks the right statistical test for your data and runs it. Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: chart
tools.description: Generate a chart from data. Ask for any chart type: bar, line, scatter, heatmap, box plot, treemap, etc. Costs 2 Makes.

tools.name: generate_diagram
tools.description: Generate a diagram from description. Types: flowchart, org_chart, process, mindmap, tree. Palettes: blue, green, purple, dark, warm. Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: generate_org_chart
tools.description: Generate an org chart. names_json: JSON array of [name, role, parent_name_or_null]. Example: [["CEO John", "CEO", null], ["VP Sarah", "VP Engineering", "CEO John"]]. Costs 2 Makes.

tools.name: create_infographic
tools.description: Create a professional infographic. stats_json/bars_json/progress_json: JSON arrays. Themes: corporate, vibrant, clean, nature, sunset. Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: create_comparison
tools.description: Create a side-by-side comparison infographic. Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: kaggle_search
tools.description: Search 200K+ Kaggle datasets by keyword. Returns dataset refs, titles, license info, download counts. Free.

tools.name: kaggle_load
tools.description: Download a Kaggle dataset and create an analysis session. Returns session_id for queries. Free.

tools.name: kaggle_analyze
tools.description: Search Kaggle, download dataset, and analyze it in one step. Costs 2 Makes for the query.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Check your getqueryly Makes balance and usage. Free.

tools.name: get_costs
tools.description: Get the Makes cost table for all operations. Free.

tools.name: ds_graph
tools.description:
Build or query a knowledge graph for an uploaded dataset (GraphRAG).
    action='build' turns the data into a graph and returns a summary.
    action='query' answers a question over the graph (e.g. 'which products share the most suppliers?').
    Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: ds_elasticity
tools.description:
Pricing sensitivity: if the dataset has discount + margin columns, compute per-segment
    margin sensitivity to discount (slope, R-squared, confidence, recommendation). Costs 1 Make.

tools.name: ds_dashboard
tools.description:
Auto-generate a Power BI-grade executive dashboard (KPIs, charts, pricing
    elasticity, impact/effort matrix, takeaways) from the uploaded dataset. Costs 2 Makes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_chat, ds_health_check · Private data: ds_upload, analyze_file · Public sink: ds_upload, analyze_file, ds_graph · Destructive: ds_health_check, ds_swarm.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_chat, ds_health_check · Private data: ds_upload, analyze_file · Public sink: ds_upload, analyze_file, ds_graph · Destructive: ds_health_check, ds_swarm

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
